title: Vocabulary
description: A vocabulary data file (actions, properties, needs, moods, traits, expressions, times of day, weather, biomes, look epochs). Display texts come from translation keys vocab.<kind>.<id>, never from this file.

description.description: Short English meaning, used in prompts and docs.

target.description: Actions only: what kind of target the action takes.

only_when.description: Actions and guard reasons: the entry exists only in one situation the core or a prompt names (e.g. build_stuck, A1373 step 2; want_check, B2668) and is offered or listed only there. A prompt that lists actions in general leaves it out; it is never an invention's purpose. Absent = an action like any other.

spoken.description: Actions only (A1510, W1728): the inhabitant's thought with this action is said aloud to the one it turns to (introducing, talking, warning, showing, teaching), so the log shows 'says' instead of 'thinks'. Absent = false (a thought).
